fields.description: LiteLLM provider name, e.g. openai, anthropic, openrouter, gemini. Any Flow Model whose Model ID starts with this provider uses these credentials unless it sets its own.
fields.label: Provider

fields.description: API key for this provider. Leave empty for local servers (Ollama, LM Studio) that don't require authentication.
fields.label: API Key

fields.description: Optional. Override the provider's default endpoint, e.g. a proxy or self-hosted gateway.
fields.label: Base URL

fields.description: Optional JSON object of provider-specific kwargs merged into every call (e.g. {"api_version": "2024-02-01"} for Azure). A model's own params take precedence.
fields.label: Extra Params
